title: fix(plugin-detail): implement `sections[].group`, bound a section's blast radius, and resolve enumerated field labels through the declared `label`
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#8497

Two defects, two commits. Base pinned at `e411c3e58`; all readings below are against that commit, not against the moving `origin/main`.

---

## Defect 1 — an authored `sections[].group` threw and blanked the page

Reproduced before touching anything, on `e411c3e58`:

```
threw: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')"
dom:   ""            <- the well-formed sibling section is gone too
```

### The card's framing of the evidence needs one correction

The card reads the spec's docblock as predicting a silent no-op, quoting `field-group-layout.ts` — *"the reference surface would accept a key the declaring surface refuses, so the reference could never resolve and the section would render nothing with nothing reported."* Read in place, that sentence is a **counterfactual**: it is the rationale for declaring `FIELD_GROUP_KEY_PATTERN` **once**, i.e. the harm that single-sourcing the key grammar *prevents*. It is not a statement about what an authored `group` does.

What the spec actually declares (installed pin `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) is a fully specified, working capability:

> `{ group: 'contact_info' }` inherits the object's `fieldGroups` entry with that key: its members … and its own presentation … all come from `deriveFieldGroupLayout` (ADR-0085 §5).

So this is a **two**-face disagreement, not three, and it resolves cleanly: the spec declares `group` as implemented; **objectui's own** props description said *"authoring it does nothing on this renderer"*; the runtime threw.

### Which side was intended — measured, not assumed

`git log -S` on the crashing expression names exactly one commit:

| commit | date | subject |
|---|---|---|
| `e997708419c1d311c2126c93762578d330cb48cf` | 2026-05-01 | feat(plugin-detail): record detail aesthetic polish (Sprint D) |

That is **months before** objectstack#13855 declared `group` (2026-08-31). The throw was never a deliberate refusal of the key — `DetailView` mapped every section through `s.fields` unguarded, `flatMap` kept the resulting `undefined` as an *element* (it flattens arrays; `undefined` is not one), and the next line read `.name` off it. **The declaration was right and the runtime had never honoured it**, which is the verdict class the brief pointed at. Hence: implement `group`, do not make it a no-op.

Resolution goes through `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` — the **same** adapter the synthesized default record page already uses, deliberately not a second derivation. That is what makes acceptance 4 true by construction rather than by coincidence.

### Blast-radius containment is two layers, because one cannot do it

The crash fires inside a `useMemo` in `DetailView`'s own body — **above** the section loop, outside every per-section subtree. A React error boundary catches what throws while rendering *its* subtree, so a per-section boundary alone could never have caught this one.

1. `sectionFieldEntries` — one tolerant spelling of "every field entry named by every section", guarding the path that actually fired.
2. Each section wrapped in the existing `SchemaErrorBoundary`, pushing its granularity from per-**component** to per-**section**, bounding every *other* way a section can throw.

An unresolvable `group` renders nothing and is reported once on the console. Existence is not a parse question — the spec assigns it to `@objectstack/lint`'s `page-section-group-unknown`, and `deriveFieldGroupLayout` already drops a declared group nothing references — so dropping is the contract; vanishing without a word is not.

## Defect 2 — enumerated `fields` reached only the i18n bundle

`DetailSection` renders `fieldLabel(objectName, field.name, field.label || field.name)` — an i18n lookup whose third argument is the fallback. The ladder is `bundle key -> field.label -> field.name`, and a spec-shaped section enumerates bare strings, which became `{ name }` with no `label`. **Rung 2 was missing entirely.**

`withDeclaredLabel` fills it from the bound object definition. Not a new source: it is the same read the group-derived body has always done (`toField`, `label: f.label || name`) — which is exactly why the platform's synthesized page showed declared labels while a hand-authored enumeration of the same fields did not.

---

## The caricature was run, not predicted — and it changed this PR twice

Caricature: swallow the throw and render nothing (the page stops crashing, the section silently disappears). Mutation proven on disk in both directions, restore proven by state (`git diff HEAD` empty **and** each blob hash equal to HEAD's).

| leg | reddens | stays green |
|---|---|---|
| **caricature** (group section dropped, not resolved) | `SECTION_GROUP_RENDERS_MEMBERS`, `BODIES_AGREE` | `SIBLINGS_SURVIVE`, `ONE_BAD_SECTION_IS_BOUNDED`, `HARNESS_KILL`, all rung legs |
| tolerant reader reverted to the bare `flatMap` | `SECTION_WITHOUT_MEMBERS_IS_BOUNDED` (with the original `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')`) | everything else |
| per-section boundary made a passthrough | `ONE_BAD_SECTION_IS_BOUNDED`, `SECTION_WITHOUT_MEMBERS_IS_BOUNDED` | everything else |
| rung 2 never filled | `RUNG_2_DECLARED_LABEL`, `RUNG_1_BUNDLE_WINS`, `BODIES_AGREE` + the three containment legs (they assert the sibling's *label*) | `RUNG_3_FIELD_NAME`, `AUTHORED_LABEL_WINS`, `SECTION_GROUP_RENDERS_MEMBERS`, `HARNESS_KILL` |

**⚠️ The stated non-regression axis does not discriminate.** The brief's axis — *"the well-formed sections still render their fields, with their labels"* — **passes under the caricature**, because the siblings are precisely what a caricature preserves. The assertion that separates the right fix from the plausible wrong one is that the **group-referenced** section renders **its own** members. Both are pinned, and the file says out loud which is which so nobody re-reads the weak one as the strong one.

**⚠️ Two guards were unpinned until the ablation said so.** With `group` implemented, a `{ group }` section is resolved into one carrying `fields` *before* `DetailView` sees it — so every group leg passed with the tolerant reader reverted. `SECTION_WITHOUT_MEMBERS_IS_BOUNDED` was added specifically to pin it, and it is the only leg that does.

**Each discriminating assertion was confirmed to execute in its own leg**, by line number, not by assumption — e.g. `RUNG_1_BUNDLE_WINS` reddens on its *third* assertion (the field the bundle does **not** cover still gets its declared label), proving the first two ran and passed rather than short-circuiting it.

**Harness-kill leg.** Every leg navigates by `requireLiveBody`, whose anchor is a section no leg is about, and whose failure text (`HARNESS DEAD: expected exactly 1 …`) is textually unlike every content assertion. It fires in both directions — zero anchors *and* duplicated anchors — so a caricature cannot satisfy the harness by adding a section. No positional navigation anywhere.

## Fixture triage — 9 pre-existing tests, three dispositions considered

Four files navigated rows by the raw field **name**, which is the behaviour defect 2 changes. All four are "change the spelling": their own object schemas already declared the labels, and their subjects (title dedupe, empty-section heuristic, `hideEmpty` retirement) are untouched. Two comments that documented the missing rung *as if it were the contract* are rewritten rather than deleted, and the one **negative** assertion among them was re-pointed so it cannot pass vacuously against a string the page no longer renders. Scanned all four for leftovers with a lit control.

## Verification

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-detail` full suite | **144 files / 1292 tests pass** |
| `packages/types` full suite | **147 files / 2807 tests pass** |
| `plugin-detail` `type-check` (both programs) | pass — and `--listFiles` proves the pin file is in the **test** program and `record-details.tsx` in the **src** program, so neither is NOT MEASURED |
| `packages/types` `type-check` (three programs) | pass |
| repo-wide `eslint .` (no narrowing needed) | **exit 0**, 4517 files, 0 errors |
| `check:control-bytes` | pass, 6769 files |
| invisible/control code points, Python scanner | 0 hits, instrument proven live by a lit control injecting U+200B / U+0000 / U+FEFF / U+00A0 via `chr()`. ⚠️ `grep -naP '[\x{200b}]'` **fails outright on this container** and, left of an `&&`, renders as a clean pass |
| `check:changeset-presence` / `check:changeset-no-major` | pass |
| governed-surface guard | 11 paths checked, none governed |

**Declared narrowings.** `check:sdui-registration-pins` exits 2 with its own *"this is not a pass — build the console first"* message; left to CI, because the diff adds and removes no registration (only a description string). The remaining `turbo --affected` packages (calendar, gantt, kanban, runner, console, examples, site) are affected through the workspace graph, not through the code touched.

## ⚠️ Overlaps objectui#7051 — please read before merging

objectui#7051 is **open**, unassigned, no linked PR, labelled `pm:on-hold`, and is *precisely* this work: *"Consume the spec section group-reference form … `record:details` sections **and** view `form.sections` resolve `group:` keys via `deriveFieldGroupLayout`"*.

- This PR delivers its **`record:details` half**.
- Its **`form.sections` half is still open**: measured on this branch, `plugin-form` reads `field.group` (field-to-group membership) but **no form-section renderer reads `section.group`**.
- **Its on-hold gate is stale.** The gate's second condition — *"objectui has adopted the `@objectstack/*` version carrying it"* — was last measured ⛔ NO on 2026-09-03. It is satisfied today: the installed pin is `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0 and it declares `group: SectionGroupKeySchema` on `RecordDetailsProps.sections[]`.

⛔ Deliberately **not** using a closing keyword for #7051 here: this PR closes only one of its two halves. Re-measure and re-queue it for the rest.

## Out of scope, filed

- objectui#8583 — `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[]` omits six member keys the spec declares (`columns`, `icon`, `description`, `showBorder`, `defaultCollapsed`, `headerColor`) and declares one it refuses (`collapsed`). This PR moves only the two members it needs (`fields` to optional, `group` added). Found by the compile-time type pin — and note `vitest` was **green** on the offending literal while `tsc` was red.

## Not done

Per the card's boundaries: no browser re-drive against a current `@objectstack/console` (the card's own measurements are the original reporter's), and `hideEmpty` is untouched.
